title: Fix Android (Clang) build errors in the interruption subsystem and the sandbox game mode
acceptance: Android arm64 Development build compiles with zero errors
description: Found packaging T-0006: Clang's -Wunreachable-code-loop-increment (an error on Android) rejects the 'for (...) return first;' pattern used to pick the first actor. MSVC accepts it, so the Windows editor build and tests never caught it. Widened to the sandbox files (T-0053 is in review) after the first completion was recorded with the wrong commit; that completion is superseded.

result.summary: Replaced the two one-pass 'first actor' loops in UETMInterruptionSubsystem (FindRig, BindMenuButton) with a single iterator check. Clang treats -Wunreachable-code-loop-increment as an error on Android; MSVC accepted them.
result.verification: Android arm64 Development C++ now compiles (the build reaches Gradle; Gradle then fails on Java 25, a separate toolchain issue). Editor build clean and all 78 ETM tests pass. Same branch as T-0053.
result.remaining: None for this fix. Packaging still needs JDK 21 (T-0006).
